newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shi'ite activist.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Pakistani Shi'ite activist.

text.p: Masked gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist on Wednesday in the town of Khenawal in Pakistan's central province of Punjab, police said.
They said Ali Hassan Jaferi, a homeopathic doctor, was shot by motorcyclists with automatic weapons as he was walking home from his clinic.
His death in hospital later sparked protest demonstrations in the town by members of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafaria party, witnesses said.
No one immediately claimed responsibility for the killing, the latest in a series of attacks on militants among Pakistan's minority Shi'ites and majority Sunni Moslems.
Tehrik-i-Jafaria's general secretary for Khanewal district, Zaheerul Hassan Tirmizi, died on hospital on Wednesday after being shot by two 10 days ago.
At least 170 people were killed in Pakistan last year in the long-running feud between militant Sunni and Shi'ite groups.
